source_audit: Wide BM256/BN128/BK2/WM8/WN1 assigns adjacent lanes to the two K32 blocks of one weight row;80/192 K32 blocks in SSM/ordinary output are even. Original weights use34 bytes/block; existing128-bit payload loads are already present.
proposal: Jointly fetch the original68-byte pair across adjacent lanes with four16-byte loads and one4-byte load at4-byte-aligned addresses. Even lane reconstructs eight payload words as(word[i]>>16)|(word[i+1]<<16); odd lane keeps words9..16. Scales retain original bits at bytes0..1/34..35, with the second passed from the even lane. Preserve zero-scale masking for padded rows, existing half add/FMA, LDS commit, K16 WMMA order and epilogues.
qualification_scope: Symbolic byte-address reconstruction only; no GPU compilation, hardware transaction measurement, operator output or performance qualification.
fallback: Original fetch for odd K32 count and all other shapes; avoid overreading final K blocks. Pair participation and clamped ragged rows must stay consistent across both lanes.
